text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seemingly relaxing her guard, Seeking<n>the Pearl finally tells me the reason<n>why she ran sideways out of the gate<n>in that scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: In a race, you never know what<n>sudden obstacle might spring up. For<n>example...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Drawing the outermost gate, getting<n>knocked down, starting late—anything<n>can happen.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to consider every<n>possibility, and test each one for<n>myself. If I do that, then I won't lose<n>hope, no matter what hurdle might<n>come my way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...So her decision to run sideways<n>was on purpose.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I am a world-class pearl, no doubt<n>about it. But even I can't rely on<n>natural talent alone to bring me<n>across the finish line every time.
choice_data_list:
But with your talent, you'd still win more often than
not...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she's neither difficult to work with,<n>nor prone to reckless behavior, then<n>Seeking the Pearl has a bright future<n>in racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even without accounting for all<n>possible hurdles, she could easily<n>rack up plenty of accolades.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You're right. My talent alone could<n>likely lead me to greater heights. In<n>the past... that guide entrusted me<n>with a similar dream.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Guide
text_block_list.text: Little Umamusume, take a good look.<n>This is the palace, dear.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Guide
text_block_list.text: If you want to live somewhere like<n>here in the future, then you have to<n>work hard, okay? I know you can do<n>it, dear.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But that wasn't the only thing she<n>said to me.

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text: Um, do you live somewhere like here<n>right now?

text_block_list.name: Experienced Guide
text_block_list.text: Of course not... I rent a small room in<n>the slums. Hence, I enjoy tourist<n>spots like this.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Guide
text_block_list.text: For folks like us, all we can do is<n>dream. But you, little miss, have<n>plenty of chances in your future. So I<n>wish you the best—for our sakes, as<n>well.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: She entrusted me with her dream...<n>but my aspirations were, and are,<n>different. I don't need a magnificent<n>mansion to live in.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I want to put the light back into the<n>eyes of those around the world<n>who've given up on their dreams!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And I'm not just referring to that<n>guide. In the skyscraper slums of that<n>city, countless people suffered every<n>single day.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Or what about those born in places<n>without opportunity? Even if they<n>have talent, they have no chance to<n>show it off to the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Our world is full of inequality. Those<n>blessed with talent and opportunity<n>win, while everyone else is left in the<n>dust.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And even if someone has everything<n>going for them, they'll still lose to an<n>opponent born with even more talent.<n>But a world decided at birth isn't<n>fabulous in the slightest, now is it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I believe that even if our starts were<n>different, with enough hard work and<n>dedication, anyone can make waves.<n>That's what I want to prove with my<n>running.
choice_data_list: I didn't know you thought that way...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We live in a big world—too big for<n>simple words of encouragement to<n>matter. But even in a world like ours,<n>there's something that can transcend<n>words and reach the hearts of<n>everyone.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...And that's races. In a race, we run,<n>compete, and aim for victory. It's a<n>simple sport, one found all across the<n>world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If I can achieve victory in spite of<n>various setbacks on a live broadcast,<n>then that'll serve as my message to<n>the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My running will connect the<n>continents of our planet! All six! Every<n>island! In a fabulous rainbow of<n>inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And that is why I refuse to rely only<n>on my talent. Instead, I want to<n>continue challenging the impossible.<n>Did that help clear things up?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For the first time, I have a clear<n>understanding of Seeking the Pearl's<n>aspirations. She doesn't want to win<n>for herself...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to inspire hope throughout<n>the world. What makes her amazing<n>isn't just her running prowess, but<n>also the motivation that compels her<n>to run.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well then, I've shown you my world<n>map.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now it's time for you to show me<n>yours, Trainer! What kind of dream do<n>you have in mind for me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What I want to accomplish with<n>Seeking the Pearl... It isn't just about<n>reaching the top of the racing world.
choice_data_list:
I want to show the world the possibilities you
possess!

I want to show the world the possibilities you
possess!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Possibilities..." You just said<n>"possibilities," did you not?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Good answer! No, perfect marks,<n>Trainer! In that case...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'll start off by showing you all my<n>current possibilities—everything I can<n>do as of this moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Pearl challenges Taiki Shuttle<n>to a rematch. They'll be running 1,200<n>meters on turf. The skies are clear,<n>and the track is in good condition.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, Pearl?! Your vibe's totally<n>changed from last time! Talk about<n>fast!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, wonderful—fabulous even,<n>Taiki! Your running's always the<n>same, rain or shine. In mile races<n>you're definitely the strongest. But!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (The conditions aren't always the<n>same. In this world, nobody ever<n>knows what'll happen next. And in<n>that world...)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: There exists a brilliant pearl that'll<n>turn yesterday's defeat into a<n>brand-new possibility! I've got your<n>rhythm down! Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, no!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Whoooooa!)

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa, looks like Seeking the<n>Pearl's still got it! I thought she'd be<n>difficult to work with, but today I can<n>sense her fire for victory!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should go scout her... I'll be<n>right back...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! ♪ To possibility and beyond!<n>Beauty calls!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Where are you going?! Wait<n>up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After Seeking the Pearl's convincing<n>win, she's mobbed by trainers<n>looking to scout her. This time,<n>however, she flies away from the<n>scene.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time later, at the summer<n>festival...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, the trainer over there! How<n>about an accessory? Hm-hm... ♪
choice_data_list: I finally found you... What are you up to?
I finally found you... What are you up to?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Can't you see? I'm running an<n>accessory shop. My daddy deals<n>with precious metals, and<n>showcasing extraordinary jewelry is<n>our family's calling.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now, what are you looking for today?<n>In my professional opinion, to really<n>make your life shine brightly...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You should choose either this golden<n>pearl or this silver pearl. Which one<n>will it be?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take a cursory glance at the<n>accessories on the table, but my<n>mind's long been made up.
choice_data_list: What I need, is Seeking the Pearl.
What I need, is Seeking the Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, great choice! We have a keen<n>customer on our hands! Then let's<n>make this pairing official.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, I bet I know what you're<n>thinking right now. "I found myself the<n>best pearl out there," right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give her my honest thoughts.<n>Hearing my reply, Seeking the Pearl<n>shows me a playful smile.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, unfortunately, you're slightly<n>mistaken. You didn't find a pearl.<n>What you found...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Was me. A girl who'd been seeking a<n>pearl named you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You are the pearl that will help me<n>shine—the only one in the whole wide<n>world.
